plugins.name: eve-memory
plugins.description: Persistent memory for Claude Code. Stores project context, preferences, decisions, and learned rules on Eve's hosted servers. Also stores conversation summaries and session logs: session start/end logs, pre-compaction conversation distillation, and transcripts passed to the extraction tool are all sent to Eve and stored. View everything at evemem.com/app, where conversation summaries and session logs can be deleted; semantic memories can be deleted with the built-in forget tool. Requires an Eve workspace and OAuth sign-in. Privacy: evemem.com/privacy
